findings: Original regex-based name normalization deletes non-ASCII letters and punctuation; distinct inputs collapse. Verified with four isolated original-function controls.
Abbreviation matching requires surrounding spaces, so prefix Dr differs from interior Dr.
No dates, patient data processing, clinical interpretation, external API, or production file mutation performed.
Inventory contains PDFs, PNG, ICNS and SVG plus generated locks and sample CSV; these remain unreviewed, not counted as viewed.

parse_fhir_dates reverses enumerate variables, treating integer index as address; one-address input raises TypeError. Multiple address dicts fail sorted before normalization. Two synthetic isolated controls reproduced errors.
read_fhir_data accesses misspelled resouce for middle name and catches only IndexError; normal resource object can raise KeyError. Static, not executed.
CLI clusters predictions at0.95 then chooses first row per cluster for uniques cache, while requested output exports full mapping. Cluster membership is not byte equality.
Cache files use fixed global temp names and are written before output extension validation; no atomic publication or per-run isolation visible. Static review only.

Structured parsing: npm451 package records, Poetry48 packages, CSV500 rows/350 truth groups with123 repeated groups. This is inventory/aggregate evidence, not dependency source review or model accuracy; no installs or input publication.

observations: FHIR input discovery materializes all lowercase-json paths before Pool.map and collects every dataframe before concat; no streaming or memory cap.
Empty/missing directory leads to empty concat rather than a complete empty-result contract; os.walk has no onerror callback to report inaccessible traversal. Static source observation.
QRDA parser explicitly NotImplementedError despite command description naming QRDA.
CSV row normalization mutates original dictionaries; only IndexError is caught during row parsing and skipped with print, without structured incomplete status.
Training fixture is mixed into input before blocking/model training, then removed from output after clustering. Effects on cluster connectivity require actual model validation, not assumed harmless.
Candidate blocking requires equal birth_date or phone (ssn+birth_date subset does not expand birth-date candidates); pairs differing in both are never compared regardless name/address similarity.
Unique-count checks use Python assert and disappear with optimization; they inspect individual fields, not joint key diversity.
Five-million-pair random sampling lacks explicit seed here; reproducibility not proven.
No Splink training, patient processing or dependencies installed/executed.
Accuracy tests assert cluster count only, not truth_value membership; wrong partition with same cluster count can pass.
Large tests cover1000/2500/5000 rows and assert nonempty output, not precision/recall. All below default10000 batch boundary.
Generator schedules every batch with same remaining_rows; child decrement not returned, so nonmultiple batch sizes can overproduce rows. Static observation, not executed.
AsyncResult handles discarded; worker errors are not retrieved by get. Generator can combine partial temp output. Static observation.
Generator fixed cwd/temp is recursively replaced and later removed; full generator not executed.
mistype configuration invokes transposition function instead of mistype function.
Single-character transposition raises ValueError; mistype(None) raises TypeError before None guard. Two isolated original-function controls reproduced failures.

Input format derived from extension: csv->CSV, xml->FHIR, everything else->TEST, including json and uppercase CSV. TEST backend ignores selected input and uses bundled training data. Static source finding, not executed.
FHIR path chosen by UI is a file whereas backend parse_fhir_data walks a directory; XML selected is routed to JSON-directory parser.
Output extension selected separately is appended to shared global resultsFile; concurrent invocations can replace shared state.
runProgram does not return PythonShell promise; IPC can resolve before computation completes. Success page follows process success without checking output existence/content.
No cancel/progress IPC implemented; renderer does not await invocation or prevent repeated clicks.
Development save source is relative resultsFile, whereas generation uses absolute __dirname path; depends on working directory.
Windows build icon references .ico absent from tree; tree contains Windows.icns instead.
No Electron launch, Python process, export copy or package script executed.
Four original identifyFormat-body controls executed: lowercase csv->CSV, json->TEST, uppercase CSV->TEST, xml->FHIR. No Electron or Python process launched.
UI suite submits only bundled CSV and checks loader/success UI plus exported size above100KB; it does not assert cluster membership, false-positive rate or selected JSON data provenance.
Many async locator assertions lack await, weakening sequencing and error propagation; locator object not-null assertions do not establish DOM element existence.
Tests share one app state and fixed export path; no independent concurrent runs, cancellation, stale-output or uppercase-extension scenario.
App-level suite was read only and not run.
Input advertises FHIR or CSV and explicitly accepts .json,.csv; JSON-to-TEST routing therefore affects an advertised path.
Error page also contains Your results are ready text, contradicting visible failure explanation.
Success instructions appropriately describe same cluster_id as possible duplicates, not confirmed identity or file deletion.
All seven output formats exposed in selector, but instructions universally say open in Excel, including XML/TeX/Feather.
Loading page has spinner only, no cancellation control or progress semantics.
